verification.notes: Verified against locally installed opencode v2.3.0. Top-level `opencode --help` does NOT expose a --model flag; `opencode run --help` exposes `--model, -m string` (provider/model#variant) and `--auto`.

non_interactive.notes: Verified via `opencode run --help`: `opencode run [flags] [<message...>]` runs non-interactively and accepts --model and --auto.
